t.why: It hosts the headquarters of Mercosur, the South American common market.
t.rel: A small country between Brazil and Argentina, considered the most stable democracy in South America. Mercosur's headquarters are in Montevideo.
t.know: In 2013 it became the first country to legalize cannabis with the state managing production and sales.
t.etext: It sells beef, pulp, soybeans and dairy, and makes most of its electricity from renewables. Stable politics and institutions give it one of the higher incomes in South America.
